genotype.statement: Table3 assigns5417G>C/C1806S to D5 and5369G>C/R1790P to B43. The packet assigns the former to B43. Discussion independently repeats R1790P,B43. This is a source patient–allele mismatch,not merely an HGVS/transcript-version uncertainty.
